debug_text.text: '[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.JAN INFO what=load_sweep_found_actor tag=' + $Tag + ' name=' + $A.name + ' marker_var=' + (@$A.$x4mp_spike) + ' temporary_flag=' + (@$A.$x4mp_temp) + ' room=' + (@$A.room.type) + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.JAN INFO what=load_sweep_stale_reference index=' + $i + ' (actor no longer exists: not saved or already removed)'

'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.JAN ' + (if $Found == 0 then 'PASS' else 'INFO') + ' what=load_sweep_done listed_before=' + $Found + ' removed=' + $Removed + ' stale=' + $Stale + ' listed_now=' + md.$X4MP_OF_Actors.count + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.1 INFO what=md_listeners on=' + global.$X4MP_OF_S1 + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.2 INFO what=md_room_key_logging on=' + global.$X4MP_OF_S2 + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.6 INFO what=md_follow_and_despawn_listeners on=' + global.$X4MP_OF_S6 + ' tag=' + global.$X4MP_OF_S6Tag + ' station=' + (@this.$Station.knownname) + ' age=' + player.age

'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.6 ' + (if md.$X4MP_OF_Actors.count == 0 then 'PASS' else 'FAIL') + ' what=interiors_despawning_cleanup actors_before=' + $Before + ' leftover=' + md.$X4MP_OF_Actors.count + ' age=' + player.age

'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.1 MEASURE side=md n=' + $N + ' age=' + player.age + ' container=' + (@player.container.knownname) + ' station=' + (@player.station.knownname) + ' ship=' + (@player.ship.knownname) + ' occupiedship=' + (@player.occupiedship.knownname) + ' room_type=' + (@$Room.type) + ' room_macro=' + (@$Room.macro.id) + ' room_dynamic=' + (if @$Room.dynamicinterior then 1 else 0) + ' walkablemodule=' + (@$Room.walkablemodule.macro.id) + ' platform=' + (@player.platform.macro.id) + ' spacesuit=' + (if @player.spacesuit then 1 else 0) + ' entity_x=' + (@$Pos.x / 1m) + ' entity_y=' + (@$Pos.y / 1m) + ' entity_z=' + (@$Pos.z / 1m) + ' entity_yaw_deg=' + (@$Rot.yaw / 1deg)

'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.1 INFO what=md_event_changed_room age=' + player.age + ' new_room_type=' + (@event.param.type) + ' new_room_macro=' + (@event.param.macro.id) + ' previous_room_type=' + (@event.param2.type) + ' previous_room_macro=' + (@event.param2.macro.id)

'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.6 ' + (if $Moved then 'PASS' else 'FAIL') + ' what=follower_replaced_in_new_room moved=' + $Moved + ' new_room_type=' + (@event.param.type) + ' actor_room_now=' + (@$F.room.type) + ' same_room_as_player=' + (@$F.room == player.room) + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.6 FAIL what=follower_missing_on_room_change tag=' + global.$X4MP_OF_S6Tag + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.1 INFO what=md_event_transport_finished age=' + player.age + ' previous_room_type=' + (@event.param.type) + ' now_room_type=' + (@player.room.type)
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.1 INFO what=md_event_player_started_control age=' + player.age + ' controlled=' + (@event.param.knownname)
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.1 INFO what=md_event_player_stopped_control age=' + player.age + ' controlled=' + (@event.param.knownname)

'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.2 INFO what=room_key label=' + $Label + ' container=' + (@$Cont.knownname) + ' container_macro=' + (@$Cont.macro.id) + ' container_seed=' + (@$Cont.seed) + ' owner=' + (@$Cont.owner.id) + ' room_macro=' + (@$R.macro.id) + ' roomtype=' + (@$R.type) + ' kind=' + (if @$R.dynamicinterior then 'dynamic' else 'static') + ' dynamic_name=' + (@$R.dynamicinterior.name) + ' walkablemodule=' + (@$R.walkablemodule.macro.id) + ' anchor_x=' + (@$Anchor.x / 1m) + ' anchor_y=' + (@$Anchor.y / 1m) + ' anchor_z=' + (@$Anchor.z / 1m) + ' chain=' + $Chain + ' walkable=' + (@$R.iswalkable) + ' age=' + player.age

'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.2 INFO what=keyset_begin label=' + $Label + ' container=' + $Cont.knownname + ' container_seed=' + (@$Cont.seed) + ' rooms=' + $Rooms.count + ' player_room_type=' + (@player.room.type) + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.2 INFO what=keyset_end label=' + $Label + ' container=' + $Cont.knownname + ' rooms=' + $Rooms.count
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.2 FAIL what=keyset label=' + $Label + ' result=no_station_or_container_for_player'

'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=spawn_no_room tag=' + $Tag + ' roomkey=' + $RoomKey + ' room=' + (@player.room) + ' platform=' + (@player.platform) + ' ship=' + (@player.ship) + ' (creating the actor unplaced so the creation path is still measured)'

'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' PASS what=actor_created_unplaced tag=' + $Tag + ' macro=' + (@$A.macro.id) + ' owner=' + (@$A.owner.id) + ' race=' + (@$A.race.id) + ' listed=' + md.$X4MP_OF_Actors.count + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' FAIL what=actor_not_created_unplaced tag=' + $Tag

'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=player_macro tag=' + $Tag + ' macro=' + player.entity.macro.id + ' race=' + (@player.entity.race.id) + ' female=' + (@player.entity.isfemale) + ' room=' + (@player.room) + ' platform=' + (@player.platform) + ' ship=' + (@player.ship)
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=create_attempt tag=' + $Tag + ' used=' + $Used + ' exists_at_create=' + ($A)

'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=slot_census tag=' + $Tag + ' room_type=' + (@$Room.type) + ' stand=' + (@$ProbeS.count) + ' npc_generic=' + (@$ProbeG.count) + ' service=' + (@$ProbeV.count) + ' wait=' + (@$ProbeW.count) + ' control=' + (@$ProbeC.count) + ' free_total=' + (@$ProbeA.count)
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=slot_search tag=' + $Tag + ' stage=' + $SlotsFrom + ' slots=' + (@$Slots.count) + ' room_type=' + (@$Room.type)

'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' ' + (if $Moved then 'PASS' else 'FAIL') + ' what=actor_spawned tag=' + $Tag + ' requested=' + $Variant + ' used=' + $Used + ' name=' + $A.name + ' macro=' + (@$A.macro.id) + ' female=' + (@$A.isfemale) + ' race=' + (@$A.race.id) + ' owner=' + (@$A.owner.id) + ' customhandler=' + $Custom + ' temporary=' + $Temp + ' marker_var_readback=' + (@$A.$x4mp_spike) + ' placed=' + $Moved + ' placed_by=' + $PlacedBy + ' slot_index=' + $SlotIdx + ' room_type=' + (@$A.room.type) + ' same_room_as_player=' + (@$A.room == player.room) + ' foot_y=' + (@$A.position.y / 1m) + ' listed=' + md.$X4MP_OF_Actors.count + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' FAIL what=actor_not_created tag=' + $Tag + ' requested=' + $Variant + ' used=' + $Used
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' FAIL what=place_failed tag=' + event.param3.{2}
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' FAIL what=place_no_actor_or_room tag=' + event.param3.{2}

'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=walk_issued tag=' + $Wanted + ' target=slot stage=' + $SlotsFrom + ' slots=' + @$Slots.count + ' slot_index=' + $SlotIdx + ' slot_dist_m=' + ($BestD / 1m) + ' speed=' + event.param3.{7} + ' iswalking=' + (@$A.iswalking) + ' actor_y=' + (@$A.position.y / 1m)
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' FAIL what=walk_no_slot tag=' + $Wanted + ' stage=' + $SlotsFrom + ' slots=' + (@$Slots.count) + ' room_type=' + (@$Room.type)
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' FAIL what=walk_no_actor_or_room tag=' + event.param3.{2}
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=sequence_issued tag=' + event.param3.{2} + ' type=' + event.param3.{3} + ' behavior=' + event.param3.{4} + ' (what it looks like is the tester observation)'
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' FAIL what=sequence_no_actor tag=' + event.param3.{2}
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=emotion_issued tag=' + event.param3.{2} + ' emotion=' + event.param3.{3}
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' FAIL what=emotion_no_actor tag=' + event.param3.{2}
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=lookat_issued tag=' + event.param3.{2} + ' on=' + event.param3.{3}

'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' MEASURE what=actor_status tag=' + $Tag + ' exists=true name=' + $A.name + ' room_type=' + (@$A.room.type) + ' room_macro=' + (@$A.room.macro.id) + ' same_room_as_player=' + $Same + ' x=' + ($P.x / 1m) + ' y=' + ($P.y / 1m) + ' z=' + ($P.z / 1m) + ' yaw_deg=' + ($A.rotation.yaw / 1deg) + ' moved_from_spawn_m=' + (if $Same and $S0 then ($P.distanceto.{$S0} / 1m) else -1) + ' walkspeed=' + (@$A.walkspeed) + ' runspeed=' + (@$A.runspeed) + ' iswalking=' + (@$A.iswalking) + ' dist_to_player_m=' + (if $Same then ($P.distanceto.{player.entity.position} / 1m) else -1) + ' age=' + player.age

'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' MEASURE what=actor_status tag=' + $Tag + ' exists=false listed=' + md.$X4MP_OF_Actors.count + ' (the tag is not in md.$X4MP_OF_Actors: the actor was never created or is gone)'
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=actors_removed which=' + $Which + ' removed=' + $Removed + ' listed_now=' + md.$X4MP_OF_Actors.count + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] ' + $Step + ' INFO what=crowd_walk_issued count=' + $Issued + ' of=' + $Count + ' room_type=' + (@$Room.type) + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.7 INFO what=conversation_started actor=' + event.object.name + ' conversation=' + event.param + ' tag=' + (@event.object.$x4mp_tag) + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.7 PASS what=next_section section=' + event.param + ' choiceparam=' + event.param2 + ' actor=' + event.object.name + ' age=' + player.age

show_notification.text: 'X4MP spike: S10.7 choice Message from ' + event.object.name
'X4MP spike: S10.7 choice Wave (the character smiles)'

debug_text.text: '[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.7 INFO what=open_conversation_menu menu=X4MPSpikeOnFootMenu'
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.7 INFO what=conversation_finished outcome=' + event.param + ' outcomeparam=' + event.param2 + ' age=' + player.age
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.9 INFO what=catalogue_begin stations_in_galaxy=' + $Stations.count + ' limit=' + $Limit + ' (own station first, then known stations that can hold interiors)'

do_if.value: $Logged lt $Limit and ($St == player.station or ($St.isknown and $St.canhavedynamicinterior and not [faction.ownerless, faction.xenon, faction.khaak].indexof.{$St.owner}))

debug_text.text: '[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.9 INFO what=station index=' + $Logged + ' name=' + $St.knownname + ' here=' + ($St == player.station) + ' sector=' + (@$St.sector.name) + ' owner=' + $St.owner.id + ' race=' + (@$St.owner.primaryrace.id) + ' canhavedynamicinterior=' + $St.canhavedynamicinterior + ' attention=' + $St.attention + ' shadyguy=' + (if @$St.shadyguy then 1 else 0) + ' shady_tradesvisible=' + (@$St.shadyguy.tradesvisible) + ' shady_room_type=' + (@$St.shadyguy.room.type) + ' rooms=' + $Rooms.count + ' dynamic_rooms=' + $NDyn + ' dynamic_types=' + $DynTypes + ' player_owned=' + ($St.owner == faction.player)
'[X4MP-SPIKE] S10.9 INFO what=catalogue_end logged=' + $Logged + ' (rooms of a station exist only while its interiors are spawned; far stations may show rooms=0)'
